name: ABC Legal
desc:
Data Entry Specialist (e-File Specialist) - Remote | $15.00/hr | Data Entry Heavy, No Sales Expected
Company: ABC Legal Services
Industry: Law and Legal Services

What a typical day will look like:
ABC Legal Services is the national leader in serving legal papers. In this role, you work from home and review and file legal documents using the company's online tools, internal systems, and email. You work with the e-Fulfillment and e-Filing team on projects, look into mismatches when they come up, and keep learning about the legal industry through ongoing training. It is steady, detail-focused computer work where accuracy matters more than speed alone. You may also pick up extra projects when they are assigned.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Accuracy on repetitive tasks
- Team player
- Curiosity and willingness to learn
- Staying focused
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. A typing test is likely since 50 to 60 WPM is required.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED
Required Experience: None needed
Preferred Experience: Data entry experience. Tech experience is strongly preferred.

Required Skills:
- Typing speed of 50 to 60 words per minute
- Exceptional attention to detail
- Able to do repetitive tasks accurately
- Basic Microsoft Office skills
- Read, write, and speak English
- Team player
- Must live in Oklahoma

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Types fast and accurately
- Likes quiet, detail-focused computer work
- Is new to the workforce or has data entry experience
- Wants full-time pay with strong benefits and a set Monday through Friday schedule

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Types under 50 words per minute
- Gets bored with repetitive tasks
- Wants a job with a lot of phone contact
- Does not live in Oklahoma
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Data entry
- Typing 50 to 60 WPM
- Document review
- E-filing
- Attention to detail
- Microsoft Office
- Accuracy
- Legal documents
- Research and problem solving
- Team collaboration

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- What is your typing speed, and how do you keep your accuracy high?
- Tell us about any data entry or computer experience you have.
- How do you stay focused when you do repetitive work?
- Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it caused a problem. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you learned a new system quickly. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $15.00/hr
-Shift: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Central.
-Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, PTO, 7 paid company holidays, 4 floating holidays per year, life and AD&D insurance, long-term disability, health care and dependent care FSAs, EAP, and pet insurance.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: OMMA friendly
-Notes: This is a remote job, but you must live in Oklahoma, and Oklahoma is listed as eligible. No experience is needed, which makes it a good starting point for newer workers. Typing speed of 50 to 60 words per minute is required, so have participants take a typing test first. Ongoing training is part of the job. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Data Entry Specialist → e-File Specialist → Senior e-Filing Specialist → e-Fulfillment Team Lead → Legal Operations Supervisor. This role builds data entry, document review, legal filing, and research skills.
